extension_description: Automatically monitor US visa appointment availability and notify when earlier slots are found

form.appointment_center_help: Hold Ctrl/Cmd to select multiple centers
form.auto_submit_warning: ⚠️ When enabled, the form will be automatically submitted when an earlier appointment is found. Use with caution
form.visit_appointment_page_first: Please visit appointment page first to get center options

status_messages.visit_website: Please open US Visa website first

tips.title: 💡 Usage Tips:
tips.step1: 1. First configure account info in settings
tips.step2: 2. Select one or more appointment centers and start monitoring
tips.step3: 3. When earlier appointment is found, form will be auto-filled and you'll be notified
tips.step4: 4. Enable "Auto Submit" to automatically complete appointment submission
tips.refresh_tip: 💡 If you don't see appointment center options, click "Refresh" button
tips.simulation_tip: 🚀 Multi-center monitoring uses random intervals to simulate human behavior
tips.warning_tip: ⚠️ Use auto-submit feature carefully, test manually first
tips.privacy_info: Account information is stored locally only, used for auto-login and appointment checking
tips.auto_save_info: 💡 Your input is auto-saved, no need to worry about losing data when switching tabs
tips.auto_guide_info: 🚀 After saving configuration, the extension will automatically guide you through login and appointment process
